input_tolerance.sentence: Incomplete input coverage: 4740 of 4764 intended stocks had usable session bars. 0 fetch names were never attempted (fetch counts include the benchmark); stocks excluded by capacity: 0; 0 scan/quality errors occurred. Results describe only the evaluated subset. 24 returned frames had no bar for 2026-11-11, each ending on the previous session, 2026-11-10. Their 2026-11-11 inputs are unknown, not measured non-matches. That is within this run's stale tolerance of 47 stocks (1% of the intended stocks), each ending within the 5 sessions before, so the stale frames do not degrade the run; the next session's run, when it publishes, reads every session they missed again.

Of the 137 mechanical A-band names without a veto, 25 are admitted and 112 are not. registry.coverage_note: A bounded manual registry of known cash-acquisition events, not a live news feed, exhaustive corporate-action screen, or clearance of unlisted stocks. Each event records its own source dates and manual review date. Unresolved events stay excluded after review_due and require a new source review; expected closing dates and go-shop deadlines never automatically clear a stock.

cash_budget.sentence: Model allocation: next-session tickets would commit $6,644.43 of the configured $30,000.00; 2 of 4 slots

notes: Risk per trade: $150.00 (0.5% of $30,000.00; his band is 0.25-1%).
Position cap: $7,500.00 (25% of equity) in any one name.
Max 4 open positions (100% of equity if all are at the cap).
Cash reuse: US stock trades generally settle T+1; a sale does not establish immediately spendable cash. Check availability and any cash-account restrictions with your broker.
Cash-account planning reference: no leverage is assumed. The site does not read your broker's settled cash or buying power; confirm available settled cash before each buy.
Plan a protective stop-market order as soon as the buy fills; verify your broker supports the intended entry and linked stop orders. Gaps and slippage can make the loss exceed planned risk.
